newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht volatile onshore, slightly weaker tone.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht volatile onshore, slightly weaker tone.

text.p: The Thai baht was more volatile and weaker in late morning trade in the onshore market on Friday as the market sought to find a level for the recently floated currency, dealers said.

The baht was trading at 28.65/28.95 per dollar onshore by 0600 GMT against 28.20/28.70 in early morning. Volumes were higher and trading more volatile as the market searched for benchmark following the baht's float on Wednesday.
"It is a little more volatile this morning and trade is more active now," said a dealer at a major commercial bank.

"Its normal commercial demand but the system is only two days old so everyone is still a little unsure. It looks like it is going to take some time to settle down, maybe next week we might see some more stability," he added.
The Bank of Thailand set the morning reference rate at 28.189 per dollar.

In the offshore market the baht also softened slightly, edging out to 28.10/29.10 per dollar from 28.69/28.80 in early morning. Trade was quiet and the market was also looking for direction, dealers said.
